items.title: Jimmy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Yeah. It was very timely because the next year Percy passed away. We had a gig in New Orleans at the New Orleans festival and I remember my sister-in-law, June, called me and I had been to see Percy and he was giving up; he was very sick and he was giving up. June called and said that Percy had passed that morning. So, we got to the gig and before we started to play I announced, “Ladies and gentleman my brother, Percy, the one from MJQ from thirty to forty years, and the most famous in the family, passed away…
And that was just this past year, 2009.
